brief.headline: Push for a 15-day earlier payment in exchange for a price cut to ₹235/kg — their price sits at the top of the fair market band (₹205–305/kg), and we can credibly threaten to move volume to two proven listed converters already on our books.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹235/kg (down from the current top-of-band level)
priceAsk.basis: The open market shows pharma/ORS laminate asking prices of ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg. Their price is at the top of that fair band. We want a price in the middle-to-lower half of fair, which ₹235 delivers — still reasonable for them but saves us meaningfully over time.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days earlier (move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt) in return for part of the price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier would tie up an extra ₹320 of our cash, so we need the price cut to more than cover that cost

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack publishes no financial information, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. That means we build our negotiating position on three things: the market price data (which shows their price is at the top of fair), our ability to move volume to two large listed converters we already buy from (Huhtamaki and UFLEX), and the early-payment sweetener (worth real money to any supplier). Because we have no visibility into their finances, we should be firm on price and terms but also line up a qualified second source fast — if they're fragile and we don't know it, we don't want to be caught short.

evidence.point: Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate ranges ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg — their price is at the top of that fair band
Paying 15 days earlier would tie up an extra ₹320 of our cash
Our total annual spend with Silk Polypack is small
BOPET film import unit value (the raw substrate) is much lower, giving us a rough floor for the base film cost

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already a tiny FDC supplier — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant that makes both the film substrate AND does conversion — can second-source at scale

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter, does pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source option (health score D 31/100, revenue ₹222.04 Cr)

risks: Silk Polypack publishes no financials, so we're flying blind on their stability — line up and qualify Huhtamaki or UFLEX now, before any supply hiccup
Our spend with them is tiny (₹7775 annually) — we have almost no volume leverage, so the threat of moving business only works if we actually execute the second-source trials

If we push too hard on price and they're cash-strapped (which we can't see), they may just walk away or delay shipments — balance firmness with keeping the relationship workable until the alternate is live
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about moving your price into the middle of the market range — around ₹235 per kg — and in return we can pay you 15 days faster, which puts cash in your hands sooner.
